title: Satellite remote sensing and artificial intelligence for livestock greenhouse gas benchmarking: measurement, attribution, and verification challenges

Livestock agriculture contributes 14.5% of global anthropogenic greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, yet current monitoring approaches carry 30–50% uncertainty, limiting credible mitigation assessment and carbon-market verification.
